 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing and constructing residential houses located at Phase I I I, Sector-A and Sector-B , Defence Housing Authority Islamabad - Rawalpindi (“ Venture ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the location and Floor Plan of the finished house the Buyer desires to purchase , as described in the Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”); and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, t he Parties intending to be legally bound, agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement (defined below), including without limitation the Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “ Buyer ”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement ( the “Agreement” ) : 
 Description of Purchased Unit 
 This Agreement to Sell 
 General Terms and Conditions 
 Nominees 
 Attachment A : Payment Plan 
 Attachment B : Purchased Unit Floor Plan 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions , followed by the Payment Plan , and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 BUYER ’S WARRANTIES 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood , and agrees to comply with this Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by t he Developer . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer , each such Buyer ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between t he Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement may be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means , together, the Agreement to Sell, these General Terms and conditions and all other documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell as may be amended or supplemented by the Developer from time to time at its sole discretion. 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective he irs, executors, administrators , successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial , capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority, including inter alia DHAI-R , which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Purchased Unit or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated C ompletion D ate 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause 4 (Construction and Possession of Purchased Unit) of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 Developer means V4 Capital , a partnership firm incorporated under the laws of Pakistan . 
 
 DHAI-R means Defence Housing Authority Islamabad - Rawalpindi 
 
 Down Payment means the amount paid by the Buyer on the signing of the agreement as per payment plan under the Agreement to Sell , equal to 30% (thirty percent) of the Purchas e Price (defined below) of the Purchased Unit , as shown in the Payment Plan . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment or instalment in the Payment Plan is required to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer in the bank account designated by the Developer . 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 13.1 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan (defined below). For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may , subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Laws means any applicable law, proclamation, decree, ministerial decision, statute, statutory instrument, order, regulation, resolution, notice, legal precedent, by-law, directive, treaty or other instruments or requirements that have the force of law within Pakistan and issued, declared, passed or given effect in any manner by any Competent Authority. 
 
 Nominee means such person , as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell to the legal heirs in the event of demise of the Buyer . 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Attachment A , setting out the Due Date, qua ntum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Purchased Unit as a residential unit in accordance with applicable laws, including inter alia the by-laws of DHAI-R . 
 
 Purchase Price means the consideration to be paid by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit, as specified in the Payment Plan, together with any Adjusted Amount which may be payable under Clause 3.3 as consideration for the sale and transfer of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer . 
 
 Purchased Unit means the specific finished house and plot that the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Terms and Conditions of the Agreement to Sell , a s per the Purchased Unit Floor Plan and the Description of Purchased Unit . 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit as shown in Attachment B to the Agreement to Sell.

 Taxes means any federal, provincial or local taxes or levies payable on any component used for the construction of the Purchased Unit (including the Component Materials) or, where the context permits, applicable on the sale or lease thereof . 
 
 Unit means any one or more finished h ouse in the V enture , including the Purchased Unit. 
 
 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to:

 Any headings in the A greement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad , Pakistan; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any U nit by t he Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of t he Developer ’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Purchased Unit , to construct and to sell the Purchased Unit and that it has received requisite approvals from Competent Authorities for the development and construction of the P urchased Unit . Further, t he Developer agrees to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from t he Developer , strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 
 
 PA YMENT 
 
 The consideration for construction and transfer of possession of the Purchased Unit by t he Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date , along with any applicable Adjusted Amount such as to constitute the entire Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit , as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Attachment A of the Agreement ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all , electricity, water , or other utility connection and meter installation charges , as per applicable laws, as and when due with respect to the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable (if any) allotment, transfer, land registration, , stamp duties, levies, taxes , CVT or any other charges whatsoever for registration or transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer; and 
 
 The Buyer ’s formal written undertaking to abide by all Laws and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit , and to make all payments of duties, taxes, levies and charges whatsoever as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit or the Buyer’s ownership thereof or other rights therein. 
 
 Both the Parties agree that the “Purchase Price” does not include any costs associated with the recording of any rights in the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale /purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) as envisaged under clause 3. 1 (iii) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall rem ain fixed under this Agreement. However, the Purchase Price may be adjusted if , between the date of signing of this Agreement and the Completion D ate, there is an increase in the price of Component Material s , as per the price indices published by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics insofar as applicable, or if there is an increase in applicable Taxes or any new Taxes . In this event, the Developer will make every possible effort for the Purchase Price to remain unaffected and ensure that the remaining Purchase Price is adjusted in a fair and reasonable manner (the “Adjusted Amount”). 
 
 The adjustment in t he Purchase Price under Clause 3. 3 shall be to the extent of increase in the price of Component Material s and Taxes only , and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount , which shall be deemed a part of the Purchase Price , at the time of possession upon completion of the P urchased Unit . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/ or Adjusted Amount on its Du e Date , without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges , conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise howsoever , all of which shall be borne by the Buyer . Such payment shall be affected by one of the following means on or before the Due Date , and the Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of the Agreement, entitling t he Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 12.1: 
 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “ V4 Capital ” ; 
 OR 
 With written notice to the Developer, b y direct transfer into the account whose details are mentioned below , or such other designated bank account bearing the same account title :

 Pursuant to the Agreement , the Buyer has made a Down Payment, receipt of which t he Developer hereby acknowledges. This Down Payment shall constitute the first Instalment Payment under the Payment Plan subject to the realisation of funds in the Developer’s designated bank account . In case the funds are not realised on the date of signing of the Agreement to Sell , this A greement shall be deemed null and void. 
 
 CONSTRUCTION AND POSSESSION OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 It is agreed and understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date represents the date by which it is presently expected that the construction of the Purchased Unit will be completed and will be ready for handover to the Buyer , whereas the Completion Date represents the actual date by which the construction of Purchased Unit is completed and is ready for handover to the Buyer . 
 
 The Developer shall issue the Co mpletion Notice to the Buyer communicating the proposed Completion Date. The Completion Date shall be the date on which t he Purchased Unit shall be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer , provided that the Buyer has fulfilled its obligations under this Agreement and paid all I nstalment Payments and any applicable Adjusted Amount under the Payment Plan . The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date, in which case the Developer shall give one (1) month’s advance notice to the Buyer. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to ( but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. The I nstalment Payment and Adjusted Amount due on possession, as indicated in the Payment Plan , shall only be payable by
